title: Log records
description:
Design the fixed-size records a log driver writes, with sequence numbers to spot lost entries.

```
record 1: seq 1, pid 4120, "opened file"
record 2: seq 2, ...
reader got seq 1, 2, 5 -> 2 records lost
```
hints: Work the text size out so the struct is exactly 128 bytes, padding included (lesson 4.03).
A gap of `next - expected` records means the buffer was full and the driver dropped them; report that number.
requirements: `struct LogRecord { std::uint64_t seq; std::uint64_t time; std::uint32_t pid; std::uint16_t length; char text[106]; };` (128 bytes, checked with `static_assert`).
Text is cut to fit and the length stored; it is not assumed to end with a zero.
The reader counts gaps in the sequence numbers.
stretch: Add a "dropped" counter record the driver writes when it can again.
